output.reason: [ev-f07fad593227] shows that the CRD's storage flag for v1beta1 changes from true to false between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0. Which version an object is stored in is set by the CRD's storage version, not by the apiVersion its manifest uses. So every SecretStore object that existed before the upgrade is stored as v1beta1, whatever API version the manifest declared. The proposed condition, gvk-in-use with version v1beta1, is too narrow: it misses SecretStores whose manifests use another served version. The exposure should match SecretStore of any version in an environment upgrading from a release below 0.16.0.

correction.statement: From 0.15.0 to 0.16.0 the storage version of secretstores.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1. Any SecretStore objects that exist before the upgrade, whatever apiVersion their manifests use, stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten. A storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update are needed before v1beta1 is removed.
